description: Use this when an agent needs Fed, ECB, and Bank of Canada policy rates and US Treasury yield curve. kind="intuitive" (default): policy rates + 10Y; kind="stats": full curve; kind="pro": curve history; kind="signals": shift and inversion state. Not endorsed by central banks. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), stats (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), signals (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), official (17 sats or $0.01 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

bank.description: Policy bank: fed, ecb, or boc.
